generationIdNote: The image_gen.imagegen response exposed only image_url and output_hint, with no generation identifier. The returned image was preserved unchanged as the raw source.

rawReview.notes: The generated sheet includes a translucent orange/brown haze and several original poses intrude into or approach their source-cell margins; pose components remain separately isolatable and no basketball appears. Preserve the raw image and use component-only cleanup for review.

cleanupNotes: Alpha-connected component isolation at threshold >64 using package-motion42.py. Detached haze components are omitted and nearest antialiased pixels assigned to their original figure. Each original pose is uniformly fit to <=251x285 and baseline-aligned in its original 5x3 cell with >=28px transparent margins. No body pixels are redrawn, synthesized, duplicated or reordered.

review.reviewNotes: Source review passes: exact 1536x1024 RGBA sheet with 15 distinct ordered poses; Piper identity, orange ponytail, uniform, proportions and shoes consistent; true transparent gutters, no ball/background/floor/grid/extra art, and complete anatomy. Windmill reads from frame4 backswing through behind-hip low sweep, knee circle, rise, peak, reach and open-hand release at frame12. Tightest cell margin is 28px, several top/bottom edges; smallest horizontal margin is 33px at frame3. Frame11 arm is bent over the head, making the reach transition less explicit than frame10 but still readable.

ballBehavior: No basketball is painted in the athlete sheet. The ball must follow Piper-specific runtime track values and release at tick21.

nativeReview.notes: Atlas is not registered. J.115 `dunk-power` is ahead in roster order; after it is integrated, review production frame selection and Piper-specific separate-ball contact in both facings at100%/120%.

packedLayoutReview.notes: Accepted: 4x4 128x96-cell proof shows all15 original pose crops once in cleaned-source row-major order, with the final bottom-right cell empty. Light/dark views show readable Piper identity/anatomy, hair, uniform and shoes, windmill progression, transparent gutters and no clipping, ball, background or haze. Fine face detail naturally reduces at atlas scale; athlete identity and poses remain legible.
